SLB.headline: SLB's OneSubsea JV Receives Aker BP Contract To Provide Subsea Production Systems, Umbilicals And Associated Services For Lyra Field Development Offshore Norway
8 Of 11 Sectors Rise Wednesday As Growth Leads
SLB.summary: Eight of 11 sectors are higher in Wednesday’s regular session, with growth sectors holding two of the top three positions and Consumer Staples completing the leading group. Energy sits well clear of the rest, separated from the next-weakest sector by a margin several times wider than any other gap in the table.
